newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oslo bourse mulls weighting of Nycomed Amersham.
newsitem.headline: Oslo bourse mulls weighting of Nycomed Amersham.

text.p: The Oslo Stock Exchange (OSE) said on Thursday it had been informed that Nycomed Amersham Plc would apply for a parallel listing on the bourse.
Nycomed Amersham is a new company to be formed by the proposed merger of Norwegian pharmaceuticals group Nycomed ASA and Britain's Amersham International Ltd.
The new group's listing will run as a continuation of Nycomed's existing listing.

The bourse said the OSE All Share Index will be calculated using all shares issued in Nycomed Amersham, in accordance with existing practice with other companies that have a primary listing on the OSE.
The consequences for the calculation of the OBX Index -- the index of the 25 most heavily traded shares on the Oslo bourse -- will be announced on July 4, it said.
